source.notes: Same POST /sap/bc/adt/debugger/watchpoints endpoint called with no query parameters at all (no variableName). Answers 400 with exc:exception type="ExceptionParameterNotFound", message "Parameter variableName could not be found.", and T100 key SADT_RESOURCE/017 with V1="variableName". Redactions performed by the capture harness before this file was written: appliance host -> 203.0.113.10:50000 (RFC 5737), application-server hostname -> a4hsandbox, Authorization/Cookie/set-cookie header values stripped. sha256/byteLength in the source .meta.json are computed over the redacted body as stored.
